_note: RATE / OFFER CONTROL — yehi ek file sab kuch chalati hai. Yahan number badlo, phir `node engine/rates.js apply` chalao: advertise page, checkout page aur Razorpay charge, teeno apne aap match karne lagenge. `standardRate` = woh rate jo offer khatam hone ke baad lagta hai (strike-through dikhta hai). `offer.discountPct` = abhi ka discount — isi se 'kitna bacha' wala hisaab banta hai. Savings ka claim isliye sach hai kyunki standardRate asli rate hai jo offer ke baad charge hoga.
